market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by widespread volume exhaustion and tight mid-channel consolidations across all asset classes. XAUUSD, XAGUSD, EURUSD, and BTCUSD remain structurally bearish beneath descending VWAPs and EMA50 baselines, yet lack yellow RVOL expansion to justify fresh short continuation into multi-touch session lows. US100 exhibits an intrabar bounce above VWAP in a negative GEX amplifying regime, but trades directly beneath Put Wall #1 (28300.97) and Gamma Flip (28321.06), capping immediate upside. All six symbols register sub-1.0 RVOL and compressed ATR envelopes, dictating a disciplined flat posture across the board.

signals.rationale: In the NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is trading inside the Value Area (VAL 3881.94, VAH 4000.33) and below POC 3978.13, hovering just above VAL. Trend structure remains bearish with price holding below declining session VWAP 3927.89 and EMA50 3905.77. Price is positioned mid-channel between ATR upper 3900.40 and ATR lower 3867.62. CVD is BEARISH (-4.36) with a slightly positive slope (+1.64), but RVOL is low at 0.749 with no yellow breakout confirmation. Price is consolidating above Session Low 3852.35 and well below S/R 3924.30. Given the lack of volume catalyst and mid-range positioning near VAL, conditions favor HOLD.

signals.rationale: During the NEW_YORK_SESSION, US100 is positioned inside the Value Area (VAL 28039.90, VAH 28295.44) and above POC 28122.95. Price is holding above VWAP 28193.13 while testing EMA50 28253.71. GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING with price below Gamma Flip 28321.06. Trapped mid-channel between S/R 28209.17 and Put Wall #1 28300.97 under a negative GEX regime, the prudent stance is HOLD.
